UUREASON FOR REFERRAL: UUTesting for the BRAF c.1799T>A (p.Val600Glu) mutation.

TEST

Test DNA extracted from tumour tissue for the c.1799T>A (p.Val600Glu)* activating mutation in the BRAF gene by DNA sequencing of standard PCR.
RESULTS

Mutation c.1799T>A (p.Val600Glu) detected. 

UUSUMMARYUU 

The BRAF c.1799T>A (p.Val600Glu) activating mutation has been detected.

UUNotes

*This mutation has been detected in approximately 52.5% of invasive melanoma [Pinzani et al. (2011) Clinica Chimica Acta 412:901-905].

Nomenclature based on BRAF Locus Reference Genomic sequence LRG_299, where nucleotide number 1 corresponds to the first base of the translation initiation codon.
